**Feature Summary**
A clear and concise description of the feature or UX improvement.

**Use Case**
Describe when and why this feature would be useful (e.g., in-car Bluetooth audio routing, custom wake words, multi-language support).

**Proposed Solution**
Any technical ideas or architectural suggestions on implementation.
